children: Greenbrier appointed Brian Comstock to serve as the railroad-equipment company's next chief executive, succeeding Lorie Tekorius.

Comstock will assume the role after Tekorius retires on Jan. 6 following Greenbrier's annual shareholder meeting, the company said Monday. He currently serves as executive vice president and president of Greenbrier's Americas business.

The company also said Tekorius won't stand for reelection to Greenbrier's board once her term expires at the 2027 shareholder meeting. She is expected to stay on after her departure date to provide transition services, the company said, and Comstock is expected to fill her board seat.
